description: SYNTHETIC offline case (H22 FRAME_SYNTHETIC, r1 interim form): construction + validation cost of SDK-shaped synthetic kline frames across three pre-registered row tiers (small 380 / medium 1705 / large 6490 total rows) cycled deterministically; one frame per timed operation; units = accepted input rows (padding/invalid/duplicate rows counted, never accepted). Measured code is the NF22-owned generator (logical module benchmark.datapipeline.frame_synthetic): the DP-owner release source-map handover is PENDING, so NO ak_trading.datapipeline production module is measured yet. This is NOT a database-throughput case (generation cost is deliberately separated from commit cost; COLLECT_STORE_SQLITE is a separate NOT_RUN leg) and NOT a PostgreSQL claim of any kind.
